name: bot-or-not
description: LAN-hosted 'Bot or Not' image guessing game

scripts.set-admin-password:
node -e "const bcrypt=require('bcryptjs'),pw=process.argv[1];if(!pw){console.error('Usage: npm run set-admin-password -- yourpassword');process.exit(1);}bcrypt.hash(pw,12).then(h=>console.log('
Add this to your .env file:
ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH='+h+'
')).catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1);});" --
